content.text: I'll start by looking at the project layout and the two files I'm allowed to change.

I added a nesting bound (`MAX_DEPTH = 64`) to the recursive-descent parser in `core/license_expr.py`: the parser now counts open parenthesised groups and raises `ParseError("nested too deeply …")` beyond 64 levels, which `core.decide.decide` already converts into `Needs review` with the reason text, so a component wrapped in hundreds of parentheses no longer raises `RecursionError` while expressions up to 64 levels (and all `OR`/`AND`/unparseable behaviour) are handled exactly as before; `core/decide.py` needed no change.
